faqIntro: Quick answers to what South African punters ask us most about licensed online betting.

faq.question: Is online betting legal in South Africa?
faq.answer: Yes. Online sports betting is legal with bookmakers licensed by a provincial gambling board under the National Gambling Act.

faq.question: What is the minimum deposit for online betting?
faq.answer: Most licensed sites let you start with as little as R5 to R50, depending on the bookmaker and payment method.

faq.question: Do South African betting sites pay out quickly?
faq.answer: Many pay out within 1 to 24 hours once your account is verified; EFT can take a little longer.

faq.question: Which are the best betting sites in South Africa right now?
faq.answer: See our ranked list above: each brand is licensed, tested with real money and reviewed by our team.

faq.question: How do I know a betting site is licensed?
faq.answer: Check the footer of the homepage for the licence number and the name of the provincial board.

faq.question: Can I bet using my phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, all our top picks offer a mobile site and most have a dedicated app.

faq.question: How do I withdraw my winnings?
faq.answer: Go to the cashier, choose Withdraw, pick your bank or e-wallet and confirm. FICA verification may be required first.

faq.question: Is online betting safe in South Africa?
faq.answer: It is safe with licensed operators that use encryption and offer responsible gambling tools.

faq.question: What is the minimum age to bet?
faq.answer: You must be 18 or older to bet online in South Africa.
